title: heleochloa compacta
intro: Heleochloa compacta, commonly known as Pampas Grass, is a type of ornamental grass native to South America. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving sleep quality, and providing relief from anxiety and stress. The therapeutic actions of Heleochloa compacta include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and sedative properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of insomnia, restlessness, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Heleochloa compacta include flavonoids, alkaloids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
